name: setup
description: Establishing premise, context, pain point, or initial curiosity hook.

name: tension
description: Heightening awareness of the problem, friction, or urgency.

name: development
description: Elaborating arguments, lifestyle opportunities, and product capabilities.

description: Direct closing call to action and next steps guidance.
